validated: bookmark folders, subfolders, rename, move, reorder and subtree confirmation
toolbar/page/address bookmark drag and pointer capture release
paint-only link colors and history clearing
actual docked/detached Network input and selected table/graph pixels

javascript.dataset: live, writable, deletable and enumerable native attribute reflection
javascript.image: real detached nodes; source fetch explicitly declined
javascript.navigator: ordinary expandos/method polyfills; actual capability fields protected

downloads.received_post_test: exact original body; one POST; exact saved NUL/non-UTF8 bytes; displayed document/current request/scroll/resource log/session history/persistent history unchanged
downloads.cancellation: final measured trace wake without stale attachment/document delivery
downloads.streaming_progress: indeterminate during bounded buffered HTTP receive

network.received_byte_definition: HTTP bytes after TLS decryption, including HTTP headers/framing; excludes TLS and TCP/IP overhead

image_orientation.independent_reference: Pillow transforms and PNG/APNG/libwebp lossless composited pixels; lossy decoder geometry is checked against its unrotated output

public_site_scope: No successful Google Search, ChatGPT or complete EFF scripted workflow is claimed. Network/scanner tests used loopback, not public scanning services.
independence: All production decoding, networking, JS, layout and rendering use original Rust code. Pillow/ImageMagick/FFmpeg are development oracles only; standard-library and Windows platform boundaries remain explicit.
